g.text: Дисплей HDMI, DC і USB touch

g.desc: Дисплей HDMI, DC і USB touch

g.text: Current-setting resistors R501 (RTL-A), R509 (HF+), R514 (T7) and R553 (IMU pack, U553) are engineering

g.desc: Current-setting resistors R501 (RTL-A), R509 (HF+), R514 (T7) and R553 (IMU pack, U553) are engineering

g.text: starting values (RILIM TBD); STACK §5.1 fixes only the rule 1.5–2× measured current. No measured device

g.desc: starting values (RILIM TBD); STACK §5.1 fixes only the rule 1.5–2× measured current. No measured device

g.text: Ворота (стенд): Measure current/inrush; set the RTL-A/HF+/T7 limits to 1.5–2× the measured current as STACK

g.desc: Ворота (стенд): Measure current/inrush; set the RTL-A/HF+/T7 limits to 1.5–2× the measured current as STACK

g.text: §5.1 requires; confirm HF+ minimum startup ≥0.75 A. Run the STACK §8 TPS2553DBVR-1 item 3 inrush test on

g.desc: §5.1 requires; confirm HF+ minimum startup ≥0.75 A. Run the STACK §8 TPS2553DBVR-1 item 3 inrush test on

g.text: latching U503 (HF+ LC 100 µH/100 µF + 220 µF damper) at final RILIM; only if it latches, fit TPS2553DBVR

g.desc: latching U503 (HF+ LC 100 µH/100 µF + 220 µF damper) at final RILIM; only if it latches, fit TPS2553DBVR

g.text: (constant-current) on this channel alone. Retry/latch test at all battery states; scope LC overshoot. IMU pack

g.desc: (constant-current) on this channel alone. Retry/latch test at all battery states; scope LC overshoot. IMU pack

g.text: branch (R-E5-08): measure the pack supply current at the J504 lead (start-up and streaming) and set R553 to

g.desc: branch (R-E5-08): measure the pack supply current at the J504 lead (start-up and streaming) and set R553 to

g.text: 1.5-2x (start 88.7k, 265-339 mA); short the far end of the 2 m cable and confirm U553 limits without latching,

g.desc: 1.5-2x (start 88.7k, 265-339 mA); short the far end of the 2 m cable and confirm U553 limits without latching,

g.text: recovers after the short is removed and LAB5 does not droop below the E1-05 limits.

g.desc: recovers after the short is removed and LAB5 does not droop below the E1-05 limits.

g.text: R501 = RILIM TBD (старт 43.2k 1%, 0.544–0.673 A). STACK для VBUS RTL-A задає лише правило RILIM = 1.5–2×

g.desc: R501 = RILIM TBD (старт 43.2k 1%, 0.544–0.673 A). STACK для VBUS RTL-A задає лише правило RILIM = 1.5–2×

g.text: виміряного струму; номінал STACK є тільки для порту LAB (R505 34.8k). Ворота: E5-04.

g.desc: виміряного струму; номінал STACK є тільки для порту LAB (R505 34.8k). Ворота: E5-04.

g.text: Received Wisecoco board DC barrel size/polarity and USBTP/USB-C touch wiring still undocumented; no-VBUS

g.desc: Received Wisecoco board DC barrel size/polarity and USBTP/USB-C touch wiring still undocumented; no-VBUS

g.text: Ворота (стенд): Obtain the exact board photo/schematic, DMM mapping, vendor confirmation and enumerate with

g.desc: Ворота (стенд): Obtain the exact board photo/schematic, DMM mapping, vendor confirmation and enumerate with

g.text: only D+/D−/GND. Never substitute guessed connector numbering.

g.desc: only D+/D−/GND. Never substitute guessed connector numbering.

g.desc: E5 - USB, VBUS, PCIe та корпусні інтерфейси (2/2)

g.text: E5-04 — OPEN, блокує випуск — STACK §5.1 (VBUS RTL-A, HF+); §8 (TPS2553DBVR-1 п. 2–3)

g.desc: E5-04 — OPEN, блокує випуск — STACK §5.1 (VBUS RTL-A, HF+); §8 (TPS2553DBVR-1 п. 2–3)

g.text: HDMI/display/hub and receiver backfeed paths through signal lines need physical power-state validation.

g.desc: HDMI/display/hub and receiver backfeed paths through signal lines need physical power-state validation.

g.text: Ворота (стенд): Verify Q6A off / LAB5 on / display on combinations using DMM/FNB58. Q6A HDMI 5 V and Q6A USB

g.desc: Ворота (стенд): Verify Q6A off / LAB5 on / display on combinations using DMM/FNB58. Q6A HDMI 5 V and Q6A USB

g.text: VBUS should remain 0 V within measurement resolution. Check DDC/HPD after U506 installation and no phantom

g.desc: VBUS should remain 0 V within measurement resolution. Check DDC/HPD after U506 installation and no phantom

g.desc: E5-06 — OPEN, блокує випуск — STACK §5.2; §8 (зворотне живлення)

g.text: Radiated-noise behavior and USB2 touch enumeration are physical integration gates, not determined by netlist.

g.desc: Radiated-noise behavior and USB2 touch enumeration are physical integration gates, not determined by netlist.

g.text: Ворота (стенд): Run the STACK A/B noise matrix (HF+, GNSS, L-band, T7 authorized=0/off), cable strain relief

g.desc: Ворота (стенд): Run the STACK A/B noise matrix (HF+, GNSS, L-band, T7 authorized=0/off), cable strain relief

g.text: and environmental tests; do not mark production-ready before passes.

g.desc: and environmental tests; do not mark production-ready before passes.

g.desc: U503 = TPS2553DBVR-1 (засувка), як у STACK §5.1/§5.2. TPS2553DBVR зі сталим струмом (LCSC C55266) — лише на

g.text: Дроти з'єднують контакти всередині функціональної групи; кожне дерево дротів має одну глобальну мітку з канонічною назвою мережі (рамка-стрілка — мережа виходить за межі групи, пряма рамка — мережа лише цієї групи). Однакові мітки з'єднані на всіх аркушах; земля — символ GND. Рамки OPEN — незакриті ворота з design/E#.json (повний реєстр: OPEN_ITEMS.md); «TBD» у значенні — STACK номіналу не задає, показано стартове значення до стенду.
